title: Mosaic view file (not a normative file)
description: Shape of a view file for `mosaic view` and `mosaic export` (docs/design.md, Implementation plan, View file). Every key is optional: an empty view file, or none, gives M2's viewer. Whether the named types and properties are in the mosaic is checked by the page, not by this schema.

search.description: How the search box searches. Default: semantic.

theme.description: Light or dark, or auto to follow the system. Default: auto.

types.description: The node types that appear, in the order written. Default: every node type, by name. A type left out is absent from the type list and tables only; search and links still reach its nodes.

edges.description: Edge types by name, each with its description on the graph explorer's map. It describes them only: every edge type still appears.

cards.description: Which facts each type's card shows, set once per type and apart from types (docs/design.md V-6, V-7, V-9, V-15). A part a card leaves out shows nothing; a type with no card gets the viewer's default. Whether the named types, properties and edge types are in the mosaic is checked by the page.

chains.description: Named chains, by label, in the order written (docs/design.md V-1, V-2, V-15, V-16, V-18). A step's link is spelled as a card's: an edge type, alone (followed out) or with in or out. A step's type is the other end of its edge type. Whether the named types, edge types and things are in the mosaic is checked by the page, which reports what it cannot apply.

types.description: Which types an export carries. By default, every type.

link.description: An edge type name, alone or followed by in or out for one direction.

start.description: The node type the chain starts from.

pin.description: The one thing it starts from, by id. Default: any thing of the start type.

steps.description: Its steps, in order. Default: none.

pin.description: The one thing this step reaches, by id. Default: any thing of its type.

show.description: Properties, or the node's summary, in the order shown. Default: none.

links.description: The things it links to by these links. Default: none.

counts.description: How many things it links to by these links. Default: none.

label.description: Shown instead of the type name. Default: the type name.

columns.description: Its table: the node's name, then these properties. Default: every declared property.

page.description: Its node page: these properties and edge types, in this order. Default: every property and every edge type.

names.description: Labels for this type's property and edge type names. Default: none, the mosaic's own names.

describe.description: Its description on the graph explorer's map. Default: none, and the map shows no description.
